reviewItem.question: Does "Dropped API versions: Kyverno 1.13 drops deprecated API versions for its managed CustomResourceDefinitions" mean a change to migration:kyverno|name=storage-version-migration (migration-required)?

proposed.statement: Kyverno 1.13 drops the deprecated kyverno.io/v2alpha1 API versions of the CleanupPolicy, ClusterCleanupPolicy and PolicyException CRDs, and existing resources at the dropped versions must be migrated — automatically by the Helm chart's migration hook, or via kube-storage-version-migrator when upgrading without Helm (or without the hook).
